shared_elements: horizontal registers of carved script signs
dense multi-line inscription filling the surface
pictographic/hieroglyphic-type signs including bird-like and hand-like forms
carved relief on a rock/stone face
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by long horizontal registers of the same kind of pictographic script signs, cut in relief and packed to fill the field, and B could plausibly be a close view of the same kind of inscribed panel seen in A. The main difference in depicted content is that A additionally shows a figural scene in the arched lunette — a winged sun disc above symmetrical standing figures flanking central emblems — which has no counterpart in B, where only script is visible.
